cases.sentence: Я увидел другого могучего ___, спускающегося с небес.
cases.translation: I saw another mighty angel descending from heaven.
cases.explain: Ангела is the direct object of the verb увидел (saw), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Его лицо было как ___, а ноги как огненные столбы.
cases.translation: His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.
cases.explain: After the comparative construction 'как', the nominative case is used.

cases.sentence: Ангел поставил правую ногу на ___, а левую на сушу.
cases.translation: He set his right foot on the sea and his left on the land.
cases.explain: The preposition на with direction of movement takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он закричал, его крик напоминал рев ___, и от этого крика заговорили семь громов.
cases.translation: He cried out with a loud voice like the roar of a lion, and when he cried, the seven thunders sounded.
cases.explain: After the noun рев (roar), the genitive case indicates possession: 'the roar of a lion'.

cases.sentence: Ангел держал в руке маленький развернутый ___.
cases.translation: The angel held a little open scroll in his hand.
cases.explain: The direct object of the verb держал (held) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Затем ___, которого я видел стоящим на море и суше, поднял правую руку к небу.
cases.translation: Then the angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted his right hand toward heaven.
cases.explain: Ангел is the subject of the main clause, requiring the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Пойди и возьми открытый ___ из руки ангела.
cases.translation: Go, and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel.
cases.explain: The direct object of возьми (take) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я взял маленький ___ из руки ангела и съел его.
cases.translation: I took the little scroll from the angel's hand and ate it.
cases.explain: The direct object of взял (took) requires the accusative case.

reading.ru: Затем я увидел другого могучего ангела, спускающегося с небес.
reading.question: What did John see descending from heaven?
reading.explain: The text says 'я увидел другого могучего ангела, спускающегося с небес' — he saw another mighty angel descending from heaven.

reading.ru: Его лицо было как солнце, а ноги как огненные столбы.
reading.question: What did the angel look like?
options: His face like the sun and his feet like pillars of fire
His face shone with twelve stars
His body glowed with rainbow colors
His form was like a figure of light
reading.correct: His face like the sun and his feet like pillars of fire
reading.explain: The text states 'Его лицо было как солнце, а ноги как огненные столбы' — his face was like the sun and his feet like pillars of fire.

reading.ru: Ангел держал в руке маленький развернутый свиток.
reading.question: What did the angel hold in his hand?
reading.explain: The text says 'Ангел держал в руке маленький развернутый свиток' — the angel held a little open scroll in his hand.

reading.ru: Когда проговорили семь громов, я приготовился писать, но голос с небес сказал мне, сохранив тайне то, что сказали семь громов, не записывай этого.
reading.question: What did John prepare to do when the seven thunders spoke, and what was he told?
options: He prepared to write but was told not to record what the seven thunders said
He prepared to sound a trumpet but was told to wait
He prepared to kneel but was told to stand
He prepared to speak but was told to remain silent
reading.correct: He prepared to write but was told not to record what the seven thunders said
reading.explain: The text says he 'приготовился писать, но голос с небес сказал мне... не записывай этого' — he prepared to write but was told not to record it.

reading.ru: Возьми его и съешь. От него у тебя будет горько в желудке, но во рту он будет сладким, как мед.
reading.question: What was John told to do with the scroll and what would it taste like?
options: Take and eat it; it would be sweet as honey in his mouth but bitter in his stomach
Take and read it carefully without eating it
Take it and give it to others to eat
Take it but do not consume it in any way
reading.correct: Take and eat it; it would be sweet as honey in his mouth but bitter in his stomach
reading.explain: The text states 'Возьми его и съешь... во рту он будет сладким, как мед' and 'будет горько в желудке' — take and eat; sweet as honey in the mouth but bitter in the stomach.

reading.ru: Тебе предстоит опять пророчествовать о судьбах многих народов, племен, языков и царей.
reading.question: What was John told to do again?
options: Prophesy about many peoples, tribes, languages, and kings
Measure the temple and count those who worship there
Sound a trumpet and warn the nations
Write down the names of all the saints
reading.correct: Prophesy about many peoples, tribes, languages, and kings
reading.explain: The text says 'Тебе предстоит опять пророчествовать о судьбах многих народов, племен, языков и царей' — he must prophesy again about many peoples, tribes, languages, and kings.
